title: Fix Capsule q Drag Palette Seed
description: Dragging Capsule Q from puzzle 3d palette crashes because catalog lacks meshUrl and resolveObjectKindMeshUrl falls back to puzzle3d://palette-seed. Rename to Capsule q and add capsule_q.glb mesh.
summary: Removed metabolism/nakagin domain logic from puzzle/3d/react (inferMetabolismMeshUrlForKindName, door-capsule relabeling, kit connector builders). Those helpers now live under puzzle/3d/play; mesh URLs stay in fixture catalog via backfill. Generic palette drop guard (resolvePuzzle3dFixtureDrop) and isLoadableMeshUrl remain in react. Tests: react 256/256, play 43/43.
